run_PerfCheckRunner: run a benchmark comparing inference settings against an fp64 baseline on default test systems
run_run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system and return energy, forces, and stress predictions
run_compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute accuracy error metrics
run_format_report_table: format benchmark results as a human-readable table with energy error, force MAE, and QPS columns
review_InferenceResult: review the InferenceResult dataclass that holds energy, forces, stress, and optional performance metrics
